Plot Isoform Expression Dynamics

Source: R/Visualize.R
plotIsoformDynamics.Rd

Plot the expression dynamics of isoforms across different developmental samples or conditions.

Usage

plotIsoformDynamics(
  combineSE,
  txid,
  gene_name = NULL,
  assay_name = "FPKM",
  group = NULL,
  group_order = NULL,
  ratio = FALSE,
  cols = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  lwd = 1.2,
  pch_size = 3
)

Arguments

combineSE

A `SummarizedExperiment` object generated by `stringtieCombine()`.

txid

Character vector. Transcript IDs to plot.

gene_name

Optional character. Gene name shown in the plot title.

assay_name

Character. Assay to use. Default is `"FPKM"`.

group

Optional character vector used to average samples by group/stage. Length must match the number of columns in the assay matrix.

group_order

Optional character vector specifying plotting order of groups.

ratio

Logical. If TRUE, plot expression ratio among selected transcripts.

cols

Optional color vector for transcript lines. Can be named by transcript ID.

main

Optional plot title. If `NULL`, generated from `gene_name`.

ylab

Optional y-axis label.

lwd

Line width.

pch

Point type.

...

Additional arguments passed to `plot()`.

Value

Invisibly returns the matrix used for plotting.
